verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a native Rootly mobile app for iOS and Android with on-call features, an Incident Summary card, and a conversational AI agent for any incident the user can access, implying some in-app incident actions are possible. However, no evidence explicitly confirms acknowledge/escalate/resolve actions are available in the mobile app, nor is there any hands-on/community corroboration of mobile on-call workflows at odd hours. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of ack/escalate/resolve buttons in the mobile app, and independent user reports of using the mobile app for on-call response.
